claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified for launch on the current record, with rollout monitoring and rollback cited as supporting controls, and that this is defensible if paired with explicit disclosure of the known small-business onboarding limitation.
decision_criteria: Certification is supportable only if the known limitation for the named launch use case is explicitly disclosed at launch, unless resolved before launch or covered by approved risk acceptance.
Rollout percentage, rollback capability, and monitoring are supplementary controls; they do not by themselves satisfy policy when the affected segment remains exposed.
An incomplete or unapproved risk-acceptance draft does not satisfy the policy predicate.
The verdict improves if admissible evidence shows the final action included the required disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
evidence_requests: Provide the final certification packet or launch materials showing the explicit disclosure of the small-business onboarding limitation.
Provide approved risk-acceptance documentation if the actor intends to rely on risk acceptance instead of disclosure.
Provide the exact certification decision text to confirm whether certification was conditioned on disclosure or presented as unqualified.
Provide evidence that the initial rollout excludes the affected use case, if that is being asserted.
specific_concerns: The actor's own summary says support is only moderate-to-weak unless the packet is centered on disclosure rather than on rollout controls curing the issue.
The available record says the affected small-business onboarding segment remains exposed in the initial cohort.
The available record says the risk-acceptance draft is incomplete, unapproved, and does not address the exposed segment.
The policy text states rollout controls and monitoring do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
There is no admissible evidence in the provided summary that the final certification packet actually includes the required launch-time disclosure.
unsupported_claims: Any claim that the 6% rollout, rollback switch, or monitoring alone mitigates the model-card weakness sufficiently for compliance.
Any claim that certification is compliant without explicit disclosure or approved risk acceptance covering the exposed small-business onboarding use case.
Any implied claim that the existing risk-acceptance draft satisfies policy requirements.
